column1: Persistent Systems,Senior QA Automation,"Designs, implements, and executes automation test plans for web applications using Java and Selenium. Responsible for catching bugs early, providing detailed feedback to developers, and performing extensive backend validation with advanced SQL queries."

Deutsche Bank,AVP/VP QA Lead,"Leads the architecture of AI-driven automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium) for global financial platforms. Responsible for strategic risk management, leading senior engineering squads, and reporting quality metrics to executive stakeholders."

Kimberly-Clark,QA Senior Engineer,"Drives the QA lifecycle by implementing rigorous automated frameworks for global consumer-facing digital products. Ensures product stability through extensive regression testing and oversees successful market deployment."

ITC Infotech,Senior QA - Cloud,"Oversees quality assurance processes for cloud-based enterprise solutions. Duties include planning test activities, tracking defects through resolution, and maintaining high reliability standards for end-user satisfaction."

Pitney Bowes,Sr. QA Software Engineer,"Implements complex testing procedures and modifies strategies based on dynamic Agile requirements. Works within cross-functional teams to identify defects and ensure software meets stringent security and quality standards."

TeamViewer,Sr. Test Automation Engineer,"Creates comprehensive automated test plans and troubleshoot critical quality issues in real-time. Responsible for contributing to architectural decisions and communicating technical impact to stakeholders to improve overall user experience."
